productionBuild.note: Product remediation is current source and pushed after verification; live marker refresh is a separate deployment evidence step.

checks.findingTitle: Scheduled briefing email can redirect workpack creation into another tenant
requiredGreenContract: The DB-backed briefing row carries immutable site_id, organization_id, and organization owner identity.
The scheduled save path derives persistence context only from that immutable site/org/owner tuple.
briefing_email remains a delivery recipient only and cannot select or alter tenant context.
Missing or mismatched immutable site/org/owner identity fails closed without inserting a workpack.
greenEvidence: app/api/briefing/run/route.ts selects id, organization_id, and organizations(owner_id) for DB-backed sites.
lib/briefing.ts drops DB rows missing site_id, organization_id, or organization owner_id.
lib/workpack-store.ts removes auth-admin email lookup and inserts scheduled workpacks from the immutable site/org/owner tuple.
BRIEFING_SITES/env fallback has no tenantContext and therefore skips workpack persistence while preserving delivery-only email behavior.

beforeDataflow.observation: The service-role site query selects name, briefing_question, and briefing_email but carries no immutable site, organization, or owner identity into the run.
site.email is passed as the owner argument to saveAskResponseAsWorkpack.
The owner argument is resolved through an admin email lookup.
The email-selected user is passed into ensureWorkspaceContext and becomes the workpack tenant context.

checks.findingTitle: Workpack archive can disclose site metadata from another tenant
requiredGreenContract: Site enrichment requires both site_id membership and organization_id membership.
A foreign site UUID cannot populate siteName, industry, or region.
The archive remains usable when a legacy or invalid site reference is omitted from enrichment.
greenEvidence: app/api/workpacks/route.ts enriches archive site metadata only when site id and organization_id both match authorized organizationIds.
tests/workpack-archive-tenant-boundary.test.ts verifies a foreign site UUID does not populate siteName, industry, or region.

beforeDataflow.observation: Archive site enrichment uses only .in("id", siteIds) and does not constrain sites by the already authorized organizationIds.

proposedVerification.scheduledBriefingFixture: Use a mocked service-role client with organization owner A and briefing email for user B; assert no B-owned context or workpack insert is possible.
proposedVerification.archiveFixture: Use owned workpack rows containing a foreign site UUID and assert the site query includes organization membership and returns no foreign metadata.
